top_signals.title: U.S. team meets with Iranians despite Trump’s annihilation threat
top_signals.summary: The U.S. president described the meeting as "very good." Iran has yet to comment on the meeting or say who attended.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Singapore’s record AI boom unlikely to move central bank, analysts say
top_signals.summary: Data shows electronics exports in August rose 132% from a year ago.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
